issues.title: A definite placeholder-mkdir failure on the NFS-compatible path leaves staging and is reported as ambiguous

Cover ENOSPC, EDQUOT, EROFS, EACCES, and EIO.

issues.title: Architectural redundancy backlog
issues.notes: D-0011 brings only independently testable cleanup into S-10. S-10 centralizes the exact-key validation mechanic used by the three public compilers (R7 partial) and adds api, boundaries, diagnostics, and functional to the executable import-boundary ratchet while correcting its charter inventory (R9 partial). R1 registry unification would change construction dispatch across applications; R2 remaining checkpoint consolidation crosses released schemas and compatibility readers; R3 facade/contract reduction changes the stable functional surface and independent Consumer boundary; R4 integrator and R5 PCG consolidation touch numerical and qualified hot paths; R6 removal of shipped pilot/lifting surfaces requires deprecation and lifting decisions; R8 qualification-history pruning changes the evidence-retention policy; the remaining R7 helpers and R9 exact legacy edges require broader migrations. Those portions remain deferred after 0.3. Under D-0013, S-10 does not join any S-09 rerun and receives no additional H100 run (R-0032 and R-0033). R-0037 accepted S-10, A-0044 integrated it into dev/0.3, and it shipped in v0.3.0rc1 and v0.3.0. D-0014 schedules the remaining work on the 0.4 development line in S-16 through S-18.
